Summary: Mid-market SaaS (RevOps platform) evaluating Hosted API first; will consider Dedicated if POC shows predictable unit economics. Primary workload: outbound SDR/chat agents that need low-latency streaming + tool-calling into CRM/email/calendar. Key ask: streaming partial token latency and reliable function/tool calling for CRM CRUD + send-email + calendar invites.

- Product/PM quote: "We need sub-300ms p50 end-to-end for streaming, p95 under 500ms for interactive flows — anything slower kills agent experience."
- Technical: prefer hosted API for quick POC; plan to benchmark with 3 agent personas (discovery, objection handling, meeting-scheduler). Expected peak concurrencies ~40-60 concurrent agents; baseline ~10-20.
- Tooling: must support structured function responses for CRM updates and idempotent operations. Need retry/fallback policies.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML) for app users; KMS integration for customer-managed keys is a plus. Data residency: US-only for PII-backed flows.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO wants 3 scenarios for monthly spend: 25k msgs, 100k msgs, 250k msgs; show Hosted vs Dedicated break-even point and effect of prefix caching and batching recommendations.
- Quote from VP Sales: "We can tolerate some degradation for background tasks but not for agent-facing streams — streaming must be 'snappy'."
- SE notes: Maya to validate streaming chunk sizes, websocket keepalive behavior, and KV cache for short-term context. Also ask Redwood for a sample function schema for CRM tool-calls.
- Legal: sent DPA draft; waiting list of redlines.
- Internal: procurement window in June (Q2 budget). If POC results are positive, they will push to an annual committed deal for Dedicated capacity.
